abstract: Thyroglossal duct cysts and dermoid cysts are two distinct lesions which can occur in the midline of the head and neck region. Different embryologic explanations for these two lesions have traditionally been accepted. Recent evidence, however, hints at an association between them. We present here a case in which both of these cysts occurred together in an unusual anatomic location, along with a discussion of the possible relationship between these two pathologic entities.
abstract_ja: 甲状舌管嚢胞と類皮嚢腫は、正中頭頸部に生じる2つの異なる病変である。両者の胚発生学的な説明は従来から別々に受け入れられてきた。しかし近年の知見は両者の関連を示唆している。本稿では、この2つの嚢胞が非典型的な部位に同時に生じた症例を提示し、両病変の関係について考察する。
